B2.label: B2 digi
B2.tool: PresentMon 2.x CSV; exact executable/version/checksum belong in run manifest

CPUFrameTime.meaning: CPU frame-start cadence, including CPU busy/wait. Not GPU work duration or display duration.

CPUBusy.meaning: CPU work interval before present; not accumulated CPU core time.

CPUWait.meaning: CPU waiting before starting the next frame.

GPUTime.meaning: GPU frame interval including GPU wait; distinct from GPU active-engine duration.

GPUBusy.meaning: Time with at least one target-process GPU engine active. Not utilization percent, exclusive feature cost or total GPU frame latency.

GPUWait.meaning: GPU idle time inside the frame GPU interval.

GPULatency.meaning: CPU frame start until GPU work begins; not GPU execution time.

DisplayedTime.meaning: Display residence time; unavailable for frames not displayed. Not renderer execution time.

DisplayLatency.meaning: CPU frame start until display; not GPU execution time.

limitations: Frame-row selection does not prove no image writes or steady state; verify the capture manifest and timing boundary.
If FrameType is unavailable, generated-frame exclusion is not established by this CSV. Disable frame generation in the renderer and record that setting.
No explicit trace-loss event count is inferred from frame data.
PresentMon metrics have different scopes; GPUTime, GPUBusy and CPUFrameTime are not interchangeable.
